segments.text: This episode follows the whole family as they try to get to Hawaii for Jay’s birthday. Gloria believes she has planned the perfect surprise: a full week in Maui.
segments.tts_text: [a warm storyteller inviting the listener into the story] This episode follows the whole family as they try to get to Hawaii for Jay’s birthday. Gloria believes she has planned the perfect surprise: a full week in Maui.
tags: [a warm storyteller inviting the listener into the story]

segments.text: Jay is delighted when he thinks the trip will be just the two of them. Then Claire, Phil, Mitchell, Cameron, the children, and Lily all arrive with their luggage. Gloria has paid for everyone to come along.
segments.tts_text: [a natural conversational storyteller] Jay is delighted when he thinks the trip will be just the two of them. Then Claire, Phil, Mitchell, Cameron, the children, and Lily all arrive with their luggage. Gloria has paid for everyone to come along.

segments.text: Jay tries to look happy, but this isn’t the quiet holiday he imagined. He wanted to sit by the pool with Gloria and read. Instead, he learns that Cameron has planned morning hikes, Manny wants to explore the island, and the family is preparing a birthday show for him.

Instead, he learns that Cameron has planned morning hikes, Manny wants to explore the island, and the family is preparing a birthday show for him.

segments.text: Every new surprise sounds worse than the last.
segments.tts_text: [a storyteller with playful humor] Every new surprise sounds worse than the last.

segments.text: Mitchell and Cameron are already arguing before they reach the airport. Cameron scheduled a playdate for Lily just before they had to leave, so Mitchell handled most of the packing. In all the confusion, Mitchell forgets his wallet and can’t board without his ID.

Cameron scheduled a playdate for Lily just before they had to leave, so Mitchell handled most of the packing. In all the confusion, Mitchell forgets his wallet and can’t board without his ID.

segments.text: Phil offers to drive him home. This creates another problem because Claire is terrified of flying and was counting on Phil to stay with her. While Phil and Mitchell race back, Claire and Cameron complain to each other about their partners.

segments.text: Claire says Phil should’ve known she needed him, even though she never directly asked him to stay. Cameron says that’s unfair and that she should simply ask for help.

segments.text: Then he complains that Mitchell should’ve known he needed help packing, even though Mitchell never directly asked either. They both realize they’re making the same argument from opposite sides.
segments.tts_text: [a storyteller with warm empathy] Then he complains that Mitchell should’ve known he needed help packing, even though Mitchell never directly asked either. They both realize they’re making the same argument from opposite sides.

segments.text: Phil and Mitchell don’t have an easy trip home. They miss turns, lock themselves out, climb through a window, and set off the house alarm. They finally get the wallet and rush back to the airport.

segments.text: The rest of the family has problems too. Manny is stopped because another person with his name is on a no-fly list, and Gloria’s angry defense of him only makes security more suspicious.

segments.text: Claire becomes more nervous as the flight gets closer and starts drinking to calm herself down.

segments.text: Jay admits that flying has started to scare him too. He says he has much more to lose now, but he’s also upset because it feels like Gloria has planned everything except time alone with him.

segments.text: Just before they board, Jay learns the final part of Gloria’s surprise. The family will return home after six days, but Jay and Gloria are staying longer by themselves. Jay immediately cheers up.

segments.text: They haven’t even left the airport yet, and the trip is already a complete mess. But Phil and Mitchell make it back, the family gets through security, and Jay finally gets the birthday holiday he was hoping for.
